blocks.text: Electron microscope electrons ki wave nature use karta hai. Tez electrons ki de Broglie wavelength visible (nazar aane wali) roshni ki wavelength se hazaron guna chhoti hoti hai. Isi liye electron microscope woh fine details (bareek cheezein) dekh leta hai jo optical microscope nahi dekh sakta. Source se nikle electrons ek electromagnetic lens se guzarte hain jise condenser kehte hain; yeh beam ko specimen (jis cheez ko dekhna hai) par focus karta hai. Beam ko kai megavolts ke voltage se tez kiya jata hai. Electrons ki speed jitni zyada, wavelength utni chhoti aur resolution (paas paas ki cheezon ko alag alag dikhane ki qabliyat) utni zyada. Ek electromagnetic lens (objective lens) specimen ki image banata hai. Electromagnetic projector lens is image ko aur bara (magnify) karta hai aur film par is ki tasveer li jati hai, jise micrograph kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Dashed axis wala vertical (khara) column. Electron source ke electrons magnetic condenser se guzar kar specimen par focus hote hain; magnetic objective first image (pehli tasveer) banata hai aur electromagnet image projector neeche second magnified image (doosri bari tasveer) banata hai.

blocks.long_description: Yeh roshni ke projector ki tarah kaam karta hai, lekin sheeshe ke lenses ki jagah magnetic lenses electrons ki beam ko modte hain. Electron ki wavelength bohat chhoti hone se kahin chhoti details nazar aati hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh bilkul roshni wale microscope jaisa hai, farq yeh hai ke sheeshe ke lenses ki jagah magnetic lenses electrons ki beam ko modte aur focus karte hain, aur roshni ki jagah electrons ki bohat chhoti wavelength kaam aati hai.
Naye (modern) versions, jinhein scanning electron microscope kehte hain, behtareen quality ki three-dimensional (3D) image de sakte hain.

Electron microscope nano-metre tak, yani taqreeban atoms ke level tak, bohat chhoti details dekh sakta hai. Is ke istemal: microbiology mein cell ki structure (banawat), viruses aur bacteria ki study; metals mein fractures (daraaron) ki jaanch; aur materials aur crystals ki structure ki study.

blocks.prompt: Electron microscope optical microscope se zyada fine details kyun dikhata hai?
blocks.explanation: Resolution istemal hone wali wavelength par depend karti hai. Tez electrons ki de Broglie wavelength visible roshni se hazaron guna chhoti hai, is liye kahin chhoti cheezein alag alag dekhi ja sakti hain.

items: Electron microscope electrons ki bohat chhoti de Broglie wavelength istemal karta hai.
Condenser, objective aur projector teeno electromagnetic lenses hain; tasveer micrograph kehlati hai.
Zyada voltage: zyada speed, chhoti wavelength, behtar resolution; scanning electron microscope 3D image deta hai.
